task: Implement distinct readable attacks for regular coastal monsters on Azure Coast. Locate AI attack contracts, telegraph and damage hit geometry, model animation channels and rendering consumers, tests and Godot port documentation before implementation; identify impact checks across core/data/render/UI/saves.
